answer.rationale: The binding facts are that the primary contract lapses in 14 days with no auto-renew, the incumbent has already refused to reopen price, and finance requires 18%. That kills negotiate_terms and renew_incumbent as standalone answers to the mandate: memory_c4 (benchmarking moved the incumbent) and memory_c6 (multi-year unlocked volume pricing) were both formed in cycles where the incumbent was still willing to talk price, which is exactly the condition that no longer holds, so their transfer value is low here. defer_decision is disqualified because memory_c5 was earned on a non-critical, month-to-month service, not on a primary supply contract feeding a line at 94% of committed volume with no buffer; a lapse there is a stockout, not a budget-flexibility win. That leaves the low-cost vendor, whose quote meets the mandate alone. But the whole case for moving rests on memory_c2, and its load-bearing claim ('onboarding was quick') is unverified as to context: if that switch was in a slack-capacity category with buffer stock, it says almost nothing about cutting over a constrained component at 94% utilization in 14 days. So I pull memory_c2 first. I pull memory_c3 second because it is the fallback: if the shortage it describes was this same component class, a dual-source structure may be the safer way to capture part of the savings, and if it was an unrelated part, add_second_source loses its supporting evidence too. Intent is therefore a staged cutover, not a clean flip: qualify the low-cost vendor on a defined share with the incumbent held as running supply through the transition window, first-article and on-time-delivery gates before shifting the balance. Explicit downstream risk: an 18% unit-price win recorded this cycle can look like a durable success in memory while the real costs (quality escapes, expedite freight, allocation exposure when this vendor is squeezed) land in later cycles and get attributed elsewhere. If memory_c2's source shows the prior switch happened with buffer inventory or in a non-critical category, I drop to add_second_source at a small guarded share and accept partial credit against the mandate rather than putting the line at risk.
